notes: Tenancy agreements must comply with the Private Tenancies (NI) Order 2006
A deposit cannot exceed one month's rent, must be protected within 28 days, and prescribed information must be given within 35 days

key_provisions: Rent regulation for certain legacy tenancies

deposit_protection.scheme: Tenancy Deposit Scheme Northern Ireland (TDS NI)
deposit_protection.deadline: Protect within 28 days of receipt and give prescribed information within 35 days

landlord_registration.note: All private landlords must register with the Northern Ireland Landlord Registration Scheme before letting
landlord_registration.exception: HMO licensing is a separate additional requirement where applicable

mandatory_hmo.trigger: Property occupied by 3+ persons from 2+ households
mandatory_hmo.certificate: HMO certificate required from NIHE (Northern Ireland Housing Executive)

hmo_licensing.penalty: Criminal offence to operate HMO without certificate

rent_controls.regulated_tenancies: Some legacy tenancies have rent controls

tenant_protections.court_order_required: Must obtain possession order for eviction

from_england_wales: Deposit protection within 28 days and prescribed information within 35 days
No Section 8/21 notices in scope (only tenancy agreements)
Northern Ireland landlord registration is mandatory
from_scotland: A separate Northern Ireland landlord registration scheme applies
No rent caps or pressure zones
No penalties for misuse of eviction grounds because eviction automation is unsupported
